requirements.text: Migrating our on-premises IBM Maximo instance to our Azure cloud tenant in Q2-Q3 2022.
Providing routine administration, patching, minor upgrade, and support services for our Maximo instance in that cloud environment for a monthly fixed managed services fee.
This contract will be valid for three (3) years with a not-to-exceed value of $200,000. The contract may be extended by one (1) additional year and amount increased at the Port's discretion.
Anticipated fixed-price not-to-exceed project cost between $25,000 and $75,000 for the migration project.
Anticipated monthly costs for managed services to range from $3,000 - $6,000 per month depending on scope/hours cap.
Consulting services for planning the project tasks, deliverables, and timeline for migrating our Maximo instance to the Port's Azure cloud tenant.
Consulting services for Azure deployment architecture to help the Port plan and size the VMs and Services the Port should provision with Microsoft in our existing Azure tenant.
requirements.overlap_notes: Deployment architecture sizing is advisory framing (Consulting) but feeds directly into Build execution — a classifier that tags this Build instead is defensible, not wrong.

requirements.text: Services to perform installation, configuration, data migration, testing, technical documentation, and go-live support to move our on-premises Maximo instance to the Port's Azure cloud tenant with minimal disruption to our users.

Future project-based work (fixed-price or time-and-materials): introduction of a mobile solution, integration with Esri GIS, HSE capabilities, custom BIRT reports, integration with financial systems, configuring or customizing Maximo application UI and workflows.
requirements.overlap_notes: Optional/future scope, not part of the priced initial project — mandatory=false is deliberate.

requirements.text: Routine Maximo administration, maintenance, patching, minor version upgrade, and support services for our Maximo instance in the Azure cloud environment for a fixed monthly fee.
Identify the proposed team (working titles, degrees, certifications, licenses), demonstrate the team's experience performing the requested services.
requirements.overlap_notes: Team-quals requirement doesn't map cleanly to one motion; labeled against the migration project since it's scored under 'Project-Based Support Services.'

requirements.text: Describe your firm's IBM Maximo qualifications, including partner level, certifications, and experience performing Maximo project-based support, enhancement, customization, and consulting work.
requirements.overlap_notes: Explicitly mixes 'consulting work' language with build/customization work — a Consulting tag would also be defensible.

requirements.text: Describe your firm's Microsoft Azure experience and qualifications, including experience performing migration of on-premises Maximo instances to an Azure cloud environment.
Complete the Vendor Cybersecurity Self-Assessment spreadsheet referenced in Attachment E and return it by email with your proposal submission.

Describe your firm's typical project approach and describe the typical deliverables and documentation you produce as part of a Maximo project (requirements, design documents, knowledge transfer documents, project plans, test plans, etc.).
Describe the Azure deployment architecture (VMs and Services) you would recommend the Port to provision in its Azure tenant to support this project.
Identify anticipated deliverables and give a timeline / project plan with key milestones and tasks for your team and the Port's team.
Describe your firm's experience providing routine administration, patching, minor upgrade, and support services for Maximo.

Include your standard Managed Services Agreement (MSA) and/or Service Level Agreement (SLA), with response and resolution times by severity, standard vs. off-hours support, and standard support hours.
Is there a cap/maximum for the number of hours that would be included for the fixed monthly fee?
requirements.overlap_notes: Directly shapes the commercial model for the managed services fee — Commercial is a defensible alternate tag.

requirements.text: Present detailed information on the firm's proposed hourly rates for performing time-and-materials project-based support services using the table in Attachment D.
Present detailed information on the firm's proposed monthly fee for providing routine Maximo administration, patching, minor upgrade, and support (managed services).

All costs/fees quoted shall be fixed, fully burdened (including administrative overhead and all direct/indirect expenses), quoted in US Dollars, and inclusive of sales tax and other government fees, taxes, and charges.

Consultant shall procure and maintain commercial general, IT Professional or Cyber Liability, and automobile liability insurance protecting against claims for bodily injury, property damage, and cyber-related risks (theft, loss or misuse of data, network breach, loss of IT systems control).

Consultant and its subconsultants agree to defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Port of Tacoma from claims arising from the Consultant's negligent acts, errors, or omissions, including cyber-related risk.

The Port of Tacoma is a public entity and must maintain access to, and be able to provide, records per RCW 40.14, RCW 42.56 and the Secretary of State's Local Government Common Records Retention Schedule; Consultant must maintain accurate records for six years post-term.
Must continue using SQL Server DB after migration to cloud (DB service or DB server on VM in Azure). DB must be encrypted.
Required Recovery Time Objective (RTO): 8 hours in the cloud environment for the Production environment.
requirements.overlap_notes: Disaster-recovery posture is also a Risk & Compliance concern; labeled Build here since it's a technical architecture spec, not a contractual/regulatory one.

requirements.text: Required Recovery Point Objective (RPO): 12 hours (amount of data which could be lost).
Microsoft Azure AD integration is used for authentication and must continue to be supported post-migration.
